title: VTG 8-Track The 4 Seasons New Gold Hits Columbia TC8 Stereo 1967 Frankie Valli
descriptionText:
Up for sale is a vintage original 8-track tape cartridge of New Gold Hits by The 4 Seasons, featuring the unmistakable sound of Frankie Valli. Released on Columbia TC8 Stereo (catalog PC-8 / 600-243), this is a true collectible for fans of 1960s pop and doo-wop.
The album includes several of the group’s classic tracks such as:
C’mon Marianne
Beggin’
Let’s Ride Again
The Puppet Song
Tell It To The Rain
Around and Around
Good-Bye Girl
I’m Gonna Change
Dody
Lonesome Road (by The Wonder Who?)

Condition:
Tape and outer slipcase show visible wear, scuffs, and edge wear consistent with age (see photos for details).
Labels are intact but show some discoloration and light stains.
Cartridge has not been play-tested; being sold as-is, for collection/display purposes.
Details:
Format: 8-Track Stereo Tape Cartridge
Label: Columbia / Philips
Year: 1967
Catalog: PC-8 / 600-243
Made in USA
A fantastic piece of 1960s music history, perfect for collectors of The 4 Seasons, Frankie Valli, or vintage 8-tracks. Don’t miss your chance to add this retro gem to your collection!
